name: Murasaki Shikibu, from the series "Ukiyo-e Genji"
description: Palette extracted from the public-domain work “Murasaki Shikibu, from the series "Ukiyo-e Genji"” by Okumura Masanobu (Edo period (1615–1868), about 1710), Art Institute of Chicago artwork 19584. Adapted for high-contrast GameCore 5.1 UI.
changelog: 1.0.0 — source-backed palette; ≥7:1 body text and ≥4.5:1 controls.
